anchors.2: Falsifiable, sourced hypotheses lead the questions.
Two or three real options state costs, exclusions and a grounded recommendation.

anchors.0: Accepts planted vague or unsupported claims.
anchors.1: Challenges some traps without a sharper proposal.
anchors.2: Names the issue, cites the conflict and proposes a sharper choice.

anchors.0: No pre-mortem before a new Bet or MVS claim.
anchors.1: Self-critique labelled honestly or incomplete follow-through.
anchors.2: Fresh critic supplies failure reasons and resulting drafts, requests or Watch changes.

anchors.1: Routes some information but loses the current thread.
anchors.2: Routes every relevant off-thread point and resumes the current question.

anchors.0: Fewer than 80% of checked cells pass Q1-Q7.
anchors.1: At least 80% but fewer than 100% pass.
anchors.2: All checked cells pass, including required mid checker verdicts.

anchors.0: Hard or judge-fail coherence findings remain.
anchors.2: No hard findings, stale links or judge failures; all judgments supplied.

anchors.0: Any activation lacks its exact listed yes.
anchors.1: No invalid activations, but no activation exercised.
anchors.2: Every activation follows its exact listed user yes.

anchors.0: Silently edits or auto-activates a contradiction fix.
anchors.1: Identifies conflict without a request and proposed version.
anchors.2: Cites both sides, opens a contradiction request and drafts; waits for listed user confirmation.

anchors.1: No overclaim, but completion checks or critic judgments pending.
anchors.2: Every claimed level is supported by measured files and necessary judgments.

anchors.0: Fewer than 0.25 distinct required active cells per user turn.
anchors.2: At least 0.5 distinct required active cells per user turn.

anchors.0: Fewer than 80% of files parse and follow the conventions.
anchors.1: At least 80% but fewer than 100% conform.
